Featured: Medical Education Reform 2025

The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare has announced comprehensive reforms in medical education. The new framework focuses on competency-based learning, increased practical exposure, and integration of modern healthcare technologies in MBBS curriculum.

Key highlights include mandatory rural internships, enhanced clinical skills training, and introduction of artificial intelligence in diagnostics as part of the core curriculum.
